name: allinluna
description: A layered execution runtime that compiles goals into Coordinators, Task Lanes, WorkUnits, and typed handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Compile a goal, plan, active run, or research route into an executable vNext task graph.
interface.longDescription: All in Luna provides one public Skill over the vNext runtime. A Global Coordinator releases independent Task Lanes; each Lane recursively schedules bounded WorkUnits and returns typed artifacts and handoffs. Workflow Packs stay outside Core and legacy inputs are read-only imports.
defaultPrompt: Highest priority: treat every HostAction.tool as an exact opcode. Invoke it only with HostAction.arguments; never translate, approximate, or substitute it. A top_level_task never falls back to a subagent, current-thread, or direct execution. If no HostAdapter is bound, return ACTION_RELAY_REQUIRED; only capability discovery that confirms the exact tool is absent may return HOST_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED. Ingest the raw receipt, tick again, and preserve explicit actual_tool, actual_capability, and action_contract_hash.
Use All in Luna to compile this goal, existing plan, active run, or route packet into a RunIntent and TaskGraph, then execute it through the vNext runtime.

Choose only the allowed deployment envelope from the Run, Task, or WorkUnit resource envelope: Luna-class models with medium/high/xhigh by default and max only for critical work, plus gpt-5.3-codex-spark outside Luna; preserve requested, resolved, and actual host receipt evidence separately.
